addresses.description: Resolved token tree in DTCG form.
What this brand offers, and where.
A brand mark composed for a named destination. Takes no parameters: the destination fixes the size, the ground and the treatment.

appearance.default: on live.css and the token artefacts, the brand's own default; on an uploaded asset, light

render.onInvalid: 400 for a value outside the list; 501 for `email`, which is reserved and may start answering after a future release.

size.default: the size the image was uploaded at

version.onInvalid: 400 when the value is not a version number like 1.2.0. 404 when it is a version number this brand has not published; that 404 is about the version, not the address, and it starts answering once that version is published.

status.400: The request named a parameter value this surface does not accept. The body says which values are accepted. Fix the request.
status.402: This brand's plan does not serve this artefact.
status.404: Nothing is served at this address. It is not reserved and will not appear later.
status.501: The address is reserved and not implemented yet. It may start answering after a future release.
